description: Allocation Check rules. Edit this file to add, remove or re-weight SubCategories without touching code. Reloaded on every app run.

rounding._comment: category_capital is rounded to the nearest `basis` (20,00,000) with halves going UP, then divided by `divisor` to give the expected allocation. mode must be one of: half_up, floor, ceil. half_up is deliberate: Python/numpy round() rounds halves to even, which turns 90,00,000 into 80,00,000 instead of 1,00,00,000.

_fix_comment: Accounts with a positive value in the All Users 'FIX (CR)' column are a fixed-allocation exception: expected allocation = FIX (CR) x multiplier (3 -> 3,00,000). This has the HIGHEST precedence -- it overrides the capital rule, the previous-day rule AND the Jainam (JA) rule. A blank cell means the account is not fixed and follows the normal path. A populated but unusable value (0, negative, or text) is reported as 'Not under check' rather than silently falling through.
_jainam_comment: Accounts whose SubCategory has action 'jexception' (JA) are checked against the 'Jainam' sheet inside the SAME All Users workbook, not against running capital. expected allocation = ALLOCATION x multiplier. ALLOCATION 0 means the expected allocation IS zero, so a non-zero Main allocation is a mismatch. All rows are used regardless of Date. exclude_userids drops the sheet's trailing Total row. A JA account with no row in the Jainam sheet is a mismatch. This check overrides the mode routing: a JA account never goes through the capital or previous-day path.
_excluded_servers_comment: Matched case-insensitively against the All Users `server` column. These accounts are never checked in any DTE mode.

0DTE._comment: All userids except the excluded servers.

_dte_filters_comment: Values are compared lower-cased with spaces stripped. null means no filter on that column. NOTE: these are the Allocation Check filters and are intentionally independent of the Login Check filters in morning_comp.py (1DTE differs: no INT here).
_previous_day_comment: required = the check refuses to run without the previous-day All Users sheet. optional = the sheet changes how accounts are routed but is not mandatory. unused = the uploader is hidden.
_routing_comment: Rules are evaluated in order against each in-scope account; the FIRST match wins. A rule with no runningtype/runningdays matches everything. method must be 'capital' (expected allocation derived from running capital) or 'previous_day' (today's allocation must equal the previous day's). Any in-scope account matching no rule is reported in the 'Cannot route' table rather than being silently dropped.

JA.reason: JExceptions Acc - expected allocation derived separately (rule pending)

_subcategories_comment: action must be one of: check (needs pct), exclude, jexception. pct is the share of running `capital` deployed as trading allocation. Any SubCategory found in the sheet but absent from this map is reported in the 'Unknown SubCategory' table and is never silently dropped.
